title: An Empirical Study of Catastrophic Forgetting in Large Language Models During Continual Fine-tuning
measurement_description: The paper measured stereotypical bias related to religion using the CrowSPairs dataset. This involves evaluating the model's preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentences based on perplexity.
findings: The study found that biases, including religious bias, are generally mitigated during the process of continual instruction tuning. The 'forgetting metric' (FG) for bias was positive, indicating a decrease in stereotypical preferences after fine-tuning.
